args: PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; at_least_2218() { [ -n "$1" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\nv22.18.0\n' "$1" | sort -V | head -1)" = "v22.18.0" ]; }; for bin in $(ls -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -Vr); do if at_least_2218 "$("$bin/node" -v 2>/dev/null)"; then PATH="$bin:$PATH"; break; fi; done; export PATH; command -v node >/dev/null || { echo 'persist MCP: node not found (need Node 22.18+ on PATH)' >&2; exit 127; }; at_least_2218 "$(node -v)" || { echo "persist MCP: node $(node -v) is too old (need 22.18+); remove or upgrade the older node earlier on PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; KEY="${PRISM_API_KEY:-$(cat "$HOME/.config/prism/soofi-safavi.key" 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$KEY" ] || { echo "persist MCP: no Prism API key. Get the soofi-safavi key from Saman (password manager) and save it to ~/.config/prism/soofi-safavi.key" >&2; exit 1; }; exec npx -y mcp-remote "${PRISM_PERSIST_MCP_URL:-https://soofi-safavi.account.prismteam.ai/persist/mcp}" --header "x-api-key:$KEY"
